title: omaCortex
consent.heading: A private memory of your day
consent.body: omaCortex records which window has focus (app and title), what is playing, and which files you open, so you and your agents can answer "where was I?". It never takes screenshots, reads window contents, or logs keystrokes. Everything stays in a local database that only you can read. Password managers, private browser windows and sign-in pages are never recorded.
summary.empty: Ask your local model to summarize today.
